sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor [n24033] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding bundle the fastener kit with one distributor.
Our latest forecast for part:360010 grows +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Today you supply 40 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 30,000 complete bundles of part:360010, part:360011, part:360012, part:360030 per year over 24 months.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the opportunity to increase our share of your volume.
In exchange for the 14-day payment terms and the binding volume, we can revise our offer to €5.50 per unit.
This price reflects the verified forecast growth and our strong interest in expanding our cooperation.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. The forecast data you referenced was already factored into our previous calculations; please provide the underlying volume data for the complete bundle to substantiate further improvements. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

We welcome the proposed 36-month contract term, as it provides valuable planning certainty for both sides. Based on the 36-month term and 90-day payment, we can revise our offer to €5.52 per unit.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This proposal remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
